headline: Japan begins phased government AI-agent rollout under a new governance standard
summary: Japan’s Digital Agency announced a staged expansion of Government AI Gennai to agent workflows and published a governance, security and safety standard. On October 30, it said a prototype app for parliamentary-answer drafting would be offered to about 180,000 government employees for trial use; 102 staff from 16 ministries had helped evaluate its development. Human review and final responsibility remain with staff. The announcements establish program scope and stated safeguards, not measured adoption, productivity, accuracy or safety outcomes.
